--------                                                                    
                                                                              
  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 16:36:                                      
                                                                              
  Bounded common-change diagnostic checkpoint plan (no production port):      
                                                                              
  Derive an independent real-white-Gaussian reference with single raw         
  periodograms from complete sample windows separated by a fixed four hops.   
  Every-other proper interior bins in 100–4000 Hz give n=83/21 at FFT2048/512.
  Pref is never an averaged/minimum/adaptive PSD and its ring advances        
  deterministically. Under this explicit Gaussian H0 only, T=(Pnew-           
  Pref)/(Pnew+Pref) is Uniform[-1,1]; its sum has an exact Irwin-Hall CDF.    
  Compute exact rational tail thresholds independently for an illustrative    
  predeclared familywise false-alarm budget <=0.001 per hour via per-frame    
  union bound. Uniform/colored/unvoiced fixtures are empirical, not exact-tail
  validation. No covariance-decorrelation => independence claim for non-      
  Gaussian noise.                                                             
                                                                              
  Add test-only reference-lifecycle/heap/reset/grouping checks and a detector 
  trace on existing inputs: 64 fixed ordinal seeds for stationary Gaussian,   
  uniform, colored Gaussian AR(.95/.995), 10/20/40 dB Gaussian steps,         
  uniform/colored 40 dB steps, synthetic wanted harmonic onset and            
  bandlimited-unvoiced onset. Add the existing three English recordings and   
  annotated recorded s/sh/p, violin and cymbal controls; use their existing   
  manifest regions, not new output-derived labels. A fixed low stationary     
  Gaussian bed prevents zero-reference singularities on clean recorded onsets.
  Preserve exact source/gain independence and chronological reference IDs.    
                                                                              
  Explicit go/no-go for any later production state rebase: all exact          
  lifecycle/oracle/zero-heap checks pass; ZERO events on                      
  stationary/voiced/unvoiced/colored/wanted controls; >=95% of 64 seeds detect
  a 40 dB common-noise increase within two FFT-window durations in both modes 
  (lower steps remain diagnostic probes). This only qualifies the event       
  hypothesis, not a production remedy. Any false alarm => NO-GO, preserve raw 
  failures and keep shipping source/default unchanged. Any subsequent actual  
  estimator candidate still faces all original vowel>=.5,36 SDR>=-.25dB,      
  settled/noise-step<=1dB, zero/profile/heap/latency/EOF guards. No tuning    
  thresholds or selection after results. Checkpoint completed diagnostics     
  separately; held-out/native scopes stay open.
